description: Solid layer integration test. Creates a Solid generative layer on a 64x64 screen, sets its fill to pure red via SetSolidColor script addressing, and asserts two goldens: compose slot 0 (the solid's own PASS 1 render target, 1920x1080 red fill) and slot 1 (the 64x64 SolidScreen after the PASS 2 blit). Covers CreateSolidLayer -> bake (GenerativeLayerSnapshot Kind::Solid + solidColor) -> PASS 1 drawColoredQuad -> PASS 2 composite. Slot order is deterministic for this script (solid RT allocates before the screen target). Regenerate with scripts/integration/record_solid_layer.json and copy test_output/solid_layer/*.hash into tests/goldens/solid_layer/.
